correctness.rationale: Proposition 4.4 gives the exact decision rule. For gamma<=alpha, threshold monotonicity gives immediate inclusion. For gamma>alpha, evaluating the required exclusion condition at t=s(X_{n+1}) and ell=1 turns the candidate risk into Q itself, so selection forces Q<=alpha and hence selection at gamma=alpha. The same substitution works in the weighted analogue. Strict witnesses were constructed on both sides of alpha and checked computationally.

value.rationale: The theorem converts an asymptotic tuning recommendation into an exact finite-sample, pathwise design rule. Within SCoRE-MDR, no search over gamma can improve any nonnegative deployment reward over gamma=alpha; the same simplification survives the known-shift weighted construction. This directly removes a tuning degree of freedom in a recent selective-risk-control method.
